name: Chao trang
summary: Cháo trắng is plain rice porridge eaten with a fish braise beside it, cá kho or kho cá cơm, the small anchovy. It is a breakfast on Da Nang’s Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
origin: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, Da Nang’s breakfast street.
howToEat: Order the porridge with whichever fish the counter is braising that morning, cá kho or kho cá cơm.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The street is busiest from about 06:00 to 08:00, and counters serve until around noon.
seoTitle: Chao trang — porridge and fish on the breakfast street
seoDescription: Cháo trắng is plain rice porridge with braised fish, cá kho or kho cá cơm, on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, Da Nang’s breakfast street.
